question: Do you think which is the best genotype imputation method?
Do you think if genotype imputation will improve genotype calls?

answers.answer: NO. genotype imputation is not needed if I have >30X data
Yes. genotype imputaion is needed for my 3X data

question: Which of the following study design will you agree to?

answers.answer: 1000 samples with 1x sequencing data, run Beagle4.1/QUILT2 genotype imputation
100 samples with 1x sequencing data, run Angsd genotype calling without genotype imputation
answers.feedback: Not Correct. this will give you bad genotype calls

answers.answer: 30 samples with 30x sequencing data, run Bcftools genotype calling without imputation
